page.overview:
Who is Mikaela?

Mikaela was a strong-willed Fremen woman who serves the royal family while longing for a home planet she’s never known.

Mikaela was working at a bar when she watched Keiran Atreides and Ynez Corrino meet up and go to a back room together.

Mikaela was working again when Horace came in with the proceeds from the Arrakis haul, minus what her spice smugglers took off the top. Keiran then came in and showed them he got scans of the palace, including the throne room. Horace wanted to use the plans to attack right away, while Keiran suggested waiting. This made Mikaela think that Keiran couldn't be trusted.

Mikaela then went to see Valya who congratulated her on the harvest attack. Then Valya asked for the names of everyone involved in the raids on Arrakis. She needed to burn the whole unit to assuage Javicco's fears. Mikaela told her to start with Keiran.
